PROVINCE NO. 4. A WHOLE WORLD OF ITS OWN.

A quieter shore.
A wider horizon.

Begin beside Phewa Lake, where the mountains appear when the skies allow. Follow the hills into stone villages, the Kali Gandaki toward Mustang, or the lowlands toward Nawalpur. Gandaki is a place to choose your own pace.

Meet Gurung and Magar hosts in the hills, the living traditions of Mustang, Newar heritage in old market towns and Tharu communities in the lowlands. Let local knowledge shape the journey, one conversation at a time.

Formerly Province No. 4 · Pokhara is the provincial capital. Population figures refer to the final 2021 census.
